`final class BitmapCell`<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.font.impl.bitmap` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [BitmapCell.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/font/impl/bitmap/BitmapCell.java)

The rectangle of a texture that holds one glyph of a bitmap font, and where that glyph sits in its line.

## Description

[`BitmapTextRenderer.getCell`](/reference/text/bitmaptextrenderer/#BitmapTextRenderer-method-getCell) returns one per glyph.
The texel coordinates pick the glyph in the texture; the bounds place it, in font pixels, from the left edge of the glyph and from the top of its ascender.
Each texel is filtered by the area it covers on screen, so the glyph stays crisp at its bitmap size and smooth at other sizes.

## Creation details

<a id="BitmapCell-factory-create"></a>

### create

`BitmapCell create(ITexture texture, int texelLeft, int texelTop, int texelRight, int texelBottom)` <span class="joid-qualifier">factory</span>

**Throws:**

- `IllegalArgumentException`: A bitmap cell needs at least one texel, got the texels …, …, …, …: give a right above the left and a bottom above the top

Creates the cell of the texels from `texelLeft`, `texelTop` included to `texelRight`, `texelBottom` excluded in `texture`; its bounds start at the size of those texels, from `(0, 0)`.
Throws `IllegalArgumentException` when the rectangle holds no texel.

## Method details

<a id="BitmapCell-method-bounds"></a>

### bounds

`this bounds(double left, double top, double right, double bottom)` <span class="joid-qualifier">fluent</span>

**Throws:**

- `IllegalArgumentException`: The bounds of a bitmap cell cannot be empty, got …, …, …, …: give a right above the left and a bottom above the top

Sets where the glyph draws, in font pixels: `left` and `right` from the left edge of the glyph, `top` and `bottom` from the top of the ascender.
Bounds larger than the texels stretch them.
Throws `IllegalArgumentException` when the bounds are empty.
